exposure: extracapsular cataract operations using the phacoemulsification technique
primary prosthetic replacement of the hip and knee joints
decompression of spinal cord and nerve roots
cohort: Patients who underwent surgery in Finland between 2011 and 2015
finding: The overall claims rate for surgical procedures in Finland was 6 per 1,000 procedures and the compensation rate was 2 per 1,000 procedures, with both rates decreasing over the study period.
mod_finding: Caesarean section had a low compensation rate.
